children: Tencent's weak financial performance will likely be temporary, Nomura analysts say in a research note. Nomura expects Tencent's 3Q revenue to grow 9% from a year earlier and adjusted operating profit to fall 3%. While Tencent's 3Q results are likely to be less robust than in previous years, the analysts think the slowdown reflects the current artificial-intelligence investment cycle and a high base of comparison for games revenue. Tencent has yet to demonstrate an AI product as compelling as those from ByteDance and Alibaba, they say. However, its coming WeChat AI agent has the potential to help establish its position in China's AI market, they add. Nomura cuts Tencent's target price to 659.00 Hong Kong dollars from HK$695.00. Shares are last at HK$417.80. (sherry.qin@wsj.com)
